rulings.updated_text: This Leader cannot attack.[Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] You may rest 1 of your DON!! cards: Select up to 1 {Egghead} type card with a cost of 5 or less from your hand and play it or add it to the top of your Life cards face-up.

rulings.source_title: Errata Cards — OP09-058 Special Muggy Ball
rulings.updated_text: [Main] Your opponent chooses 1 of their Character with a cost of 6 or less and return to the owner's hand.
Trait line corrected from Fish-Man to Merfolk per official errata list.

rulings.source_title: Errata Cards — ST14-014 Gum-Gum Giant Rifle
rulings.updated_text: [Counter] If there is a Character with a cost of 8 or more, up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +3000 power during this battle.[Trigger] Add up to 1 of your Character cards with a cost of 2 or less from your trash to your hand.
[End of Your Turn] ①: Set this Character as active.[Once Per Turn] If this Character would be K.O.'d, you may rest 1 of your Characters with a cost of 3 or more other than [Pica] instead.

rulings.source_title: Errata Cards — OP03-054 Usopp's Rubber Band of Doom!!!
rulings.updated_text: [Counter] Up to 1 of your Leader or Character cards gains +2000 power during this battle. Then, you may trash 1 card from the top of your deck. [Trigger] Draw 1 card and you may trash 1 card from the top of your deck.

[DON!! x1] When this Character's attack deals damage to your opponent's Life, you may trash 7 cards from the top of your deck. [On Play] Return up to 1 Character with a cost of 3 or less to the owner's hand, and you may trash 2 cards from the top of your deck.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When a DON!! card on the field is returned to your DON!! deck, this Leader gains +1000 power during this turn.
